conclusion: Verified on 2026-10-28: CHARMD CODEXMV database hosted by CNR Herpesvirus, Limoges (URL: https://www.unilim.fr/cnr-herpesvirus/outils/codexmv/database/) contains exclusively Cytomegalovirus (Human betaherpesvirus 5), targeting CMV genes (UL27, UL51, UL54, UL56, UL89, UL97). Zero HSV-1 or HSV-2 resistance mutations are present in the online CHARMD database.
